content_zh:
但草儿完全没有注意到身旁仆役们怜悯的目光，她很小心注意手中的水盆，免得半路就被她不小心弄倒，终于顺利进到三公子的院落，推开房门，进到内房里，准备叫三公子起床。
她先把温水放在盆架上，然后就来到床边，好奇地看着躺在床上的男人，他有着非常有型的剑眉，鼻梁也又高又挺，再配上一双有棱有角的薄唇，看起来就是个非常有个性的男人。
她虽然偶尔在花园里扫地时会看到戚家的四位公子，但都是远远的观望着，从来没有这么近距离看过，所以感到很好奇、很新鲜，原来传说中的三公子就长得这个模样。
「好好看……」心脏扑通扑通地跳着，她从来没有这么近的瞧着他，有种奇怪的害羞感，不知不觉便被他沉睡好看的表情给吸引住了。
她喜欢这张沉睡的脸蛋，第一眼看到就有种说不出的好感，所以她更是不懂，为什么其他姊妹会避他如蛇蝎，连靠近都不敢靠近。
她在床边瞧了好一会儿，才想起自己必须赶紧叫三公子起床，戚管家有吩咐，三公子每天都要早起练武，却又总是一熟睡就很难醒过来，需要丫鬟将他给唤醒，所以要她无论如何都要把他给叫醒，免得他晚起之后一整天都心情不好，这样就会有很多人遭殃的。
她伸出手，有些害羞地轻拍他放在被外的臂膀，小小声地喊着：「三公子，该起床了。」
然而熟睡的男人一动也没动，像是完全没有听到，果然睡得很沈。
她只好鼓起多一点勇气，加重拍打他的力道，提高音量，再度喊道：「三公子，该起床了！」
结果男人还是不为所动，依旧睡得死死死，像是就算天整个塌下来也砸不醒他一样。
「一点反应都没有，怎么办呢……」她轻蹙起眉，显得非常困扰。
「丫头，要叫醒三公子的不二法门就是绝对不能够心软，使尽你所有吃奶的力气给他拍下去就是，然后千万
「一定要闪开，
想起戚管家千叮咛万交代的事情，她还是非常迟疑，一定得这么做才能叫得醒三公子，真的没别的办法吗？
还有，为什么要闪开？她想不透，不过她没有继续思考下去，反正照着做就是了。
她看着自己纤细的手，终于下定决心，听戚管家的话做准没错，因为戚管家人很好，绝对不会诓人的！
「好吧，那……我要使尽所有吃奶的力气了……」她深吸一口气，终于豁出去地将掌心一挥而下，很有气势的大喊：「快点起来——」
啪地一大声，她重重地朝他臂上打下去，打得她的手都跟着痛了起来，她下意识地收回手，拚命揉着自己的掌心，眼角微微泛出泪，却见三公子依旧不动如山，像是对她的吃奶力气根本就不痛不痒一样。
她傻眼的瞪着床上的男人，没想到这样子还是叫不醒他，她很沮丧、难过，她果然只适合做扫地的工作而已，连叫三公子起来这种小事情她也做不好，她在换工作的第一天就把自己的新工作给搞砸了。
正当草儿难过得皱起柳眉，不知道该如何是好之际，床上的男人却突然之间有了动作，他以迅雷不及掩耳的速度坐起身，伸手掐住就站在床旁的草儿脖子，开始发起他的起床气来——

「该死！痛死人了，是哪个家伙这么不要命了？」
她狠狠倒抽一口气，下意识地想要往后退，但掐住她脖子的力道又缩紧不少，害她只能瞪大双眼，僵在原地，完全无法动弹。
戚无秋火大地扒开垂散在前额的发丝，继续咆哮：「吵什么吵？本公子睡得正好，哪个想死的家伙这么……」
他发泄到一半，终于有些回过神来，看着床边被自己给掐住纤细小脖子的可怜小丫鬟，瞬间感到莫大的心虚，意识到自己的火爆起床气又在第一天吓坏新来的丫鬟了。
「戚管家没有告诉你，叫醒我之后就要快点闪，才不会无辜遭殃吗？」他心虚归心虚，但说话的口气依旧不善，就像是在骂她一样。
她只是微张着嘴、瞪大着眼，俨然已经彻底被吓坏似的，一句话也说不出口，脸色非常苍白。
戚无秋有些懊恼的微微申吟出声，他似乎已经可以预见，待会儿这个小丫鬟绝对会吓得冲出他的房，在外头又哭又叫的缩在角落频频发抖，就像之前无数个丫鬟一样。
他抹抹脸，将刚起床的难看脸色赶紧给抹掉，尽可能地努力扬起和蔼可亲的笑容，放柔语气地说：「丫头，答应我一件事情，好吗？」
她还是没有任何动作，只不过苍白的脸色变得更惨白，显然已经惊吓过度了。
「在我放开手之后，你不要尖叫、不要大哭、不要冲出门去，我只是一时失手不小心抓住你，完全没有恶意，所以你绝对不要害怕，好吗？」音调放软放软再放软，但她到底有没有听进去啊？
吓傻的人儿依旧没有任何反应，但再这样僵持下去也不是办法，戚无秋只好当作她已经听进去了。「那好，我现在松手，答应我，绝对不要冲出去。」
戚无秋轻轻松开自己的手，本以为草儿会不顾一切地转身夺门而出，和其他的丫鬟没什么两样，但神奇的，她竟然听话的没有逃跑、没有尖叫、没有痛哭，还是乖乖的站在原地，只不过那脸色……似乎比刚才更加难看了。
「丫头，你……还好吗？」他担心地碰碰她肩膀。
没想到他不碰还好，一碰就惨了，草儿瞬间大翻白眼，身体一软，根本就是彻底昏过去，比又哭又叫的夺门而出还糟糕呀！
「小心！」他动作俐落地猛一往前伸手，将她给抱住，然后翻个身让自己居于下方，成为她名副其实的垫背。
「喔！该死，痛死我了！」
戚无秋的肚子被昏倒的草儿一压，差点吐出胆汁来，他的后脑勺也狠狠地在地板上撞了一下，瞬间头昏脑胀，全身上下痛得让他很想打人。
他拍拍倒在他身上的小丫头，痛得暂时无法坐起身来。「喂，丫头，你快点醒醒，真有这么可怕吗？快点给我醒来……」
他还真是第一次遇到直接昏倒给他看的丫鬟，这到底是哪里来的丫头，胆小如鼠到这种程度，他反过来也被她给吓坏了。
「真的是……啧！」他认了认了，谁教他先失手掐了人呢？是他理亏在先，活该一早醒来就吃苦活受罪。

不知道过了多久，草儿终于从沉沉的昏睡中苏醒过来。
她慢慢睁开眼，发现脑袋还有些昏沉沉的，而她现在正躺在三公子房里靠窗边的卧榻上，窗外艳阳高照，让她全身都热了起来。
「你这个丫头，可终于醒了。」
「呃？」她赶紧坐起身来，才发现软榻旁的椅子上坐了一名男子。
男子身穿暗红色的上好绸衣，有型的剑眉微扬，双手环抱在胸前，隐隐散发着难以掩饰的霸气，有种不怒而威的感觉，让人不容忽视。
他正是戚家的三公子，戚无秋，是无戚镖局的主事者，也是草儿必须服侍的新主子。
哇，他睁开眼之后看起来更是英气好看了……
草儿有些沉迷地瞧着戚无秋的脸，心脏又不受控制地狂跳着，之后才猛然想起自己要服侍主子起床的事情，便赶紧走下榻，来到水盆边，窸窸窣窣地开始弄了起来。
content_en:
But Cao'er didn't notice the pitiful looks of the servants beside her at all. She paid careful attention to the water basin in her hand, so as not to accidentally knock it over halfway. She finally entered the Third Young Master's courtyard smoothly, opened the door, and entered the inner room, ready to wake the Third Young Master up.
She first put the warm water on the basin stand, then came to the bedside and looked curiously at the man lying on the bed. He had very stylish sword eyebrows, a high and straight nose bridge, and a pair of angular thin lips. He looked like a man with a very unique personality.
Although she occasionally saw the four young masters of the Qi family while sweeping the floor in the garden, she always watched them from a distance. She had never seen them so close before, so she felt curious and fresh. It turned out that the legendary third young master looked like this.
"It looks good..." Her heart was beating loudly. She had never looked at him so closely before. She felt strangely shy and was unknowingly attracted by his handsome expression while sleeping.
She liked this sleeping face, and she had an indescribable fondness for him when she first saw it, so she didn't understand why the other sisters would avoid him like snakes and scorpions, not even daring to get close.
She stared at the bedside for a while before remembering that she had to wake up the third young master quickly. Butler Qi had given orders that the third young master had to get up early every day to practice martial arts, but it was always difficult to wake up once he fell asleep. She needed the maid to wake him up, so she had to wake him up no matter what, lest he would be in a bad mood all day after getting up late, which would cause many people to suffer.
She stretched out her hand, shyly patted his arm outside the quilt, and shouted softly: "Third Young Master, it's time to get up."
However, the sleeping man didn't move at all, as if he didn't hear anything at all. Sure enough, he was sleeping deeply.
She had no choice but to muster up a little more courage, slap him harder, raise her voice, and shout again: "Third Young Master, it's time to get up!"
As a result, the man remained unmoved and still slept soundly, as if even if the sky fell, he would not be able to wake him up.
"There's no reaction at all, what should I do..." She frowned slightly, looking very troubled.
"Girl, the only way to wake up the Third Young Master is to never be soft-hearted, just use all your strength to pat him down, and then do it ten thousand times
"You must get out of the way,
Thinking of what Butler Qi had told him, she was still very hesitant. She had to do this to wake up the Third Young Master. Is there really no other way?
Also, why do you want to get out of the way? She couldn't figure it out, but she didn't continue to think about it. She just did it anyway.
She looked at her slender hands and finally made up her mind to listen to Butler Qi's words and do the right thing, because Butler Qi's family is very good and would never trick anyone!
"Okay, then...I'm going to use all my strength to suck the milk..." She took a deep breath, finally waved her palm down with all her might, and shouted with great force: "Get up quickly——"
With a loud snap, she hit him hard on the arm, causing pain in her hand. She subconsciously retracted her hand and rubbed her palms desperately. Tears welled up in the corners of her eyes, but she saw that the third young master remained motionless, as if he was not bothered by her sucking power.
She stared at the man on the bed dumbfounded. She didn't expect that she couldn't wake him up like this. She was frustrated and sad. She was really only suitable for sweeping the floor. She couldn't even do such a small thing as waking up the third son. She messed up her new job on the first day of changing jobs.
Just when Cao'er frowned in sadness and didn't know what to do, the man on the bed suddenly made a move. He sat up at lightning speed, reached out and pinched Cao'er's neck, who was standing next to the bed, and started to get up -
"Damn! It hurts so much. Who is so desperate for his life?"
She took a deep breath and subconsciously wanted to step back, but she held backThe strength in her neck tightened so much that she could only stare wide-eyed and freeze in place, unable to move at all.
Qi Wuqiu fiercely pulled away the hair that was hanging on his forehead and continued to roar: "Why are you making such a fuss? I slept just fine, who wants to die like this..."
Halfway through his venting, he finally came to his senses. Looking at the poor little maid beside the bed who had her slender neck strangled by him, he instantly felt guilty and realized that his hot temper had frightened the new maid on the first day.
"Didn't Butler Qi tell you that you have to move quickly after waking me up so that no innocent people suffer?" He felt guilty, but his tone of voice was still unkind, as if he was scolding her.
She just opened her mouth slightly and widened her eyes, as if she was completely frightened. She couldn't say a word and her face was very pale.
Qi Wuqiu groaned slightly in annoyance. He seemed to have foreseen that this little maid would be so frightened that she would rush out of his room and cry and scream outside, huddled in the corner and trembling frequently, just like countless other maids before.
He wiped his face and quickly wiped away the ugly look on his face that he had just gotten up from. He tried his best to put on an amiable smile and said in a gentle tone: "Girl, promise me something, okay?"
She still didn't make any movement, but her pale face became even paler, and she was obviously too frightened.
"After I let go, don't scream, don't cry, don't rush out the door. I just accidentally caught you by mistake. There is no malice at all, so you must not be afraid, okay?" The tone was softer, softer, and softer, but did she listen?
The frightened person still didn't react at all, but there was no way to continue the stalemate like this. Qi Wuqiu had to pretend that she had listened. "Okay, I'll let go now and promise me you'll never rush out."
Qi Wuqiu gently let go of his hand. He thought that Cao'er would turn around and rush out of the door desperately, just like other maids. But miraculously, she was obedient and did not run away, scream or cry. She still stood there obediently, but her face... seemed to be even uglier than before.
"Girl, are you... okay?" He touched her shoulder worriedly.
Unexpectedly, it was okay if he didn't touch it, but it would be terrible if he touched it. Cao'er instantly rolled his eyes, his body went limp, and he almost fainted completely. It was worse than running out of the door crying and screaming!
"Be careful!" He quickly reached forward and hugged her, then turned over so that he was underneath, becoming her veritable support.
"Oh! Damn it, it hurts so much!"
Qi Wuqiu's stomach was pressed by the unconscious Cao'er, and he almost vomited bile. The back of his head hit the floor hard, and he felt dizzy for a moment. The pain all over his body made him want to hit someone.
He patted the little girl who fell on him. The pain was so painful that he couldn't sit up for the time being. "Hey, girl, wake up quickly. Is it really so scary? Wake up quickly..."
This was the first time he met a maid who passed out directly in front of him. Where did this girl come from? She was so timid as a mouse, and he was frightened by her in turn.
"It's really...tsk!" He admitted it. Who taught him to accidentally pinch someone first? He was the one who was wrong in the first place and deserved to suffer the hardships when he woke up early in the morning.
I don't know how long it took, Cao'er finally woke up from his deep sleep.
She slowly opened her eyes and found that her head was still a little groggy, and she was now lying on the couch by the window in the third son's room. The bright sun outside the window made her whole body warm.
"You girl, you finally woke up."
"Huh?" She quickly sat up and found a man sitting on the chair next to the soft couch.
The man was wearing a dark red fine silk coat, with a slightly raised eyebrow and his arms folded in front of his chest.Domineering, with a feeling of power without anger, which cannot be ignored.
He is the third son of the Qi family, Qi Wuqiu, the person in charge of the Wuqi Escort Agency, and the new master that Cao'er must serve.
Wow, he looked even more handsome and handsome when he opened his eyes...
Cao'er looked at Qi Wuqiu's face with some fascination, her heart beating wildly uncontrollably, and then she suddenly remembered that she had to help her master get up, so she hurriedly walked out of the bed, came to the water basin, and started rustling.
